{{Quote|Viridian Squad's a bunch of blasted heroes.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Tso]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
'''Viridian Squad''' was a military unit of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]], commanded by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Tso]] and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Era Jung]]. On [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], Jung led the Viridian Squad on a reconnaissance mission to the [[Temple of Sacrifice]], but the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was ambushed by the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]]. Most of them, including Jung, were [[Death/Legends|killed]] and the survivors taken captive. Jung's final report on a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] was found by a member of the [[Yavin Coalition]], who rescued the survivors and delivered the report to Major Tso who proclaimed the Viridian Squad as heroes and promised to put them all for a commendation.
